objects.definition: typedef int HelError;
objects.description: Alias for int representing an error or success value. Typically used as return codes; exact semantics and value ranges are not defined in this header.

objects.definition: typedef int HelAbi;
objects.description: Alias for int indicating an ABI version or identifier. Specific meaning and valid values are not defined in this header.

objects.definition: typedef int64_t HelHandle;
objects.description: Alias for int64_t used as an integer handle to identify a kernel resource. Lifetime and ownership semantics are not defined in this header.

objects.definition: typedef int64_t HelNanotime;
objects.description: Alias for int64_t representing a time value in nanoseconds. No epoch or monotonic/real-time semantics are specified here.

HelError is referenced as the syscall return/error code type but not defined in this header. Its actual definition must come from included headers (e.g., hel.h/hel-types.h). No custom type is defined here.
Opaque handle type used for kernel objects. It is only referenced here; the definition is external to this header. No custom type is defined here.
Machine word-sized integer used by the syscall stubs. Only referenced here; defined elsewhere.
Severity enum for helLog; only referenced here. Not defined in this header.
Flags for helTransferDescriptor; declaration/definition is external. Only referenced here.
Descriptor metadata structure used by helDescriptorInfo; only referenced here. Not defined in this header.
Parameter block for helCreateQueue; referenced only. Not defined here.
Allocation restriction parameters for helAllocateMemory; referenced only. Not defined here.
Exit information structure for virtualized CPU runs; referenced only. Not defined here.
ABI selector for thread creation; referenced only. Not defined here.
Statistics structure for threads; referenced only. Not defined here.
Describes asynchronous message-passing actions; referenced only. Not defined here.
Kernlet binding data union; referenced only. Not defined here.
Register set metadata; referenced only. Not defined here.

No custom types are defined in this header. It only conditionally includes an architecture-specific header and emits an error for unsupported architectures. Therefore, there are no structs, enums, typedefs, or classes explicitly defined here.
x86 segment register snapshot used in virtualization/register operations.
x86 descriptor table (GDT/IDT) descriptor with base and limit.
Complete register image for x86 virtualization, including GPRs, segment registers, descriptor tables, control registers, and MSRs.
Direction for helTransferDescriptor: copy out to another universe or into current.
Scatter/gather buffer item with pointer and length.
IPC action descriptor used in helSubmitAsync; union-like fields carry data/descriptor depending on type.
Result structure for helDescriptorInfo describing a descriptor type.
Flags for helAllocateMemory behavior (continuous, on-demand).
Allocator restrictions for helAllocateMemory (e.g., physical address width).
Flags for managed memory behavior (readahead hint).
Managed memory management request kinds delivered to userspace managers.
Flags controlling helMapMemory and protection semantics.
Flags for slice view creation; write-combine cache hint.
Flags describing thread creation or state (stopped).

functions.name: helLog
functions.signature: extern inline __attribute__ (( always_inline )) HelError helLog(const enum HelLogSeverity severity, const char *string, size_t length)
functions.description: Writes a log message with the given severity to the kernel log. Pass a pointer to a character buffer and its length.
requirements: string must point to at least length bytes of readable memory
length specifies the number of bytes to log (not necessarily NUL-terminated)

functions.name: helPanic
functions.signature: extern inline __attribute__ (( always_inline )) void helPanic(const char *string, size_t length)
functions.description: Triggers a kernel panic with the given message and length. This call does not return.
requirements: string must point to at least length bytes of readable memory
This function does not return; callers must not rely on continuation after the call

functions.name: helNop
functions.signature: extern inline __attribute__ (( always_inline )) HelError helNop()
functions.description: Performs a no-op syscall to test connectivity or measure overhead.

functions.name: helSubmitAsyncNop
functions.signature: extern inline __attribute__ (( always_inline )) HelError helSubmitAsyncNop(HelHandle queueHandle, uintptr_t context)
functions.description: Submits a no-op operation to an async queue with an associated opaque context.
requirements: queueHandle must be a valid queue handle

functions.name: helCreateUniverse
functions.signature: extern inline __attribute__ (( always_inline )) HelError helCreateUniverse(HelHandle *handle)
functions.description: Creates a new universe/descriptor namespace and returns its handle.
requirements: handle must be a non-null pointer to writable memory to receive the created handle

functions.name: helTransferDescriptor
functions.signature: extern inline __attribute__ (( always_inline )) HelError helTransferDescriptor(HelHandle handle, HelHandle universe_handle, enum HelTransferDescriptorFlags direction, HelHandle *out_handle)
functions.description: Transfers a descriptor between universes or duplicates it based on direction flags, returning a new handle.
requirements: out_handle must be a non-null pointer to writable memory
handle must be a valid descriptor handle
universe_handle must be a valid universe handle
direction must be a valid HelTransferDescriptorFlags value

functions.name: helDescriptorInfo
functions.signature: extern inline __attribute__ (( always_inline )) HelError helDescriptorInfo(HelHandle handle, struct HelDescriptorInfo *info)
functions.description: Retrieves information about a descriptor into info.
requirements: info must be a non-null pointer to writable memory
handle must be a valid descriptor handle

functions.name: helGetCredentials
functions.signature: extern inline __attribute__ (( always_inline )) HelError helGetCredentials(HelHandle handle, uint32_t flags, char *credentials)
functions.description: Obtains credentials associated with a handle into a caller-provided buffer. Exact format and size are unspecified here.
requirements: credentials must point to writable memory sufficient for the credentials data (size/format unknown)
handle must be valid
flags must be a valid bitmask for this operation (exact meaning unknown)

functions.name: helCloseDescriptor
functions.signature: extern inline __attribute__ (( always_inline )) HelError helCloseDescriptor(HelHandle universeHandle, HelHandle handle)
functions.description: Closes a handle within the given universe.
requirements: universeHandle must be a valid universe handle
handle must be a handle owned by the specified universe

functions.name: helCreateQueue
functions.signature: extern inline __attribute__ (( always_inline )) HelError helCreateQueue(const struct HelQueueParameters *params, HelHandle *handle)
functions.description: Creates an async queue according to params and returns its handle.
requirements: params must point to a valid, initialized HelQueueParameters structure
handle must be a non-null pointer to writable memory

functions.name: helCancelAsync
functions.signature: extern inline __attribute__ (( always_inline )) HelError helCancelAsync(HelHandle handle, uint64_t async_id)
functions.description: Attempts to cancel a previously submitted async operation identified by async_id on the given handle.
requirements: handle must be valid
async_id must refer to a pending async operation on the handle

functions.name: helDriveQueue
functions.signature: extern inline __attribute__ (( always_inline )) HelError helDriveQueue(HelHandle handle, uint32_t flags)
functions.description: Drives processing of an async queue, honoring flags.
requirements: handle must be a valid async queue handle
flags must be a valid bitmask for queue driving (specifics unknown)

functions.name: helAllocateMemory
functions.signature: extern inline __attribute__ (( always_inline )) HelError helAllocateMemory(size_t size, uint32_t flags, const struct HelAllocRestrictions *restrictions, HelHandle *handle)
functions.description: Allocates a kernel-managed memory object of the given size with flags and optional restrictions, returning its handle.
requirements: handle must be a non-null pointer to writable memory
If restrictions is non-null, it must point to a valid HelAllocRestrictions structure
size specifies the desired allocation size; must be non-zero if required by the OS (exact constraints unknown)
flags must be a valid bitmask for memory allocation (semantics unknown)

functions.name: helResizeMemory
functions.signature: extern inline __attribute__ (( always_inline )) HelError helResizeMemory(HelHandle handle, size_t size)
functions.description: Resizes a memory object to the specified size.
requirements: handle must be a valid memory handle
size is the new size; constraints such as alignment or maximum size are unknown

functions.name: helCreateManagedMemory
functions.signature: extern inline __attribute__ (( always_inline )) HelError helCreateManagedMemory(size_t size, uint32_t flags, HelHandle *backing_handle, HelHandle *frontal_handle)
functions.description: Creates a managed memory pair, returning separate backing and frontal handles.
requirements: backing_handle and frontal_handle must be non-null pointers to writable memory
size is the requested size; constraints unknown
flags must be valid for managed memory (semantics unknown)

functions.name: helCopyOnWrite
functions.signature: extern inline __attribute__ (( always_inline )) HelError helCopyOnWrite(HelHandle memoryHandle, uintptr_t offset, size_t size, HelHandle *outHandle)
functions.description: Creates a copy-on-write view/derivative of a memory object over the specified range, returning a new handle.
requirements: memoryHandle must be a valid memory handle
outHandle must be a non-null pointer to writable memory
offset and size define the range; must be within the source object (exact constraints unknown)

functions.name: helAccessPhysical
functions.signature: extern inline __attribute__ (( always_inline )) HelError helAccessPhysical(uintptr_t physical, size_t size, HelHandle *handle)
functions.description: Obtains a handle that provides access to a physical memory range.
requirements: handle must be a non-null pointer to writable memory
physical is a physical address; must be valid and appropriately aligned if required (exact constraints unknown)
size must be non-zero and within allowed limits (unknown)

functions.name: helCreateIndirectMemory
functions.signature: extern inline __attribute__ (( always_inline )) HelError helCreateIndirectMemory(size_t numSlots, HelHandle *handle)
functions.description: Creates an indirect memory object with a specified number of slots for indirection.
requirements: handle must be a non-null pointer to writable memory
numSlots specifies the number of slots; must be > 0 (assumed from naming; exact minimum unknown)

functions.name: helAlterMemoryIndirection
functions.signature: extern inline __attribute__ (( always_inline )) HelError helAlterMemoryIndirection(HelHandle indirectHandle, size_t slotIndex, HelHandle memoryHandle, uintptr_t offset, size_t size)
functions.description: Alters a slot in an indirect memory object to reference a region of another memory object.
requirements: indirectHandle must be a valid indirect memory handle
slotIndex must be within the number of slots created (exact bounds unknown)
memoryHandle must be a valid memory handle
offset and size must describe a valid range within memoryHandle

functions.name: helCreateSliceView
functions.signature: extern inline __attribute__ (( always_inline )) HelError helCreateSliceView(HelHandle bundle, uintptr_t offset, size_t size, uint32_t flags, HelHandle *handle)
functions.description: Creates a slice/view of a bundled memory or similar object at the given offset and size, returning a handle.
requirements: bundle must be a valid handle of the expected type (slice-capable)
handle must be a non-null pointer to writable memory
offset and size must specify a valid range within the bundle
flags must be a valid bitmask for slice creation (semantics unknown)

functions.name: helForkMemory
functions.signature: extern inline __attribute__ (( always_inline )) HelError helForkMemory(HelHandle handle, HelHandle *out_handle)
functions.description: Forks/duplicates a memory object, returning a new handle to the forked object.
requirements: handle must be a valid memory handle
out_handle must be a non-null pointer to writable memory

functions.name: helCreateSpace
functions.signature: extern inline __attribute__ (( always_inline )) HelError helCreateSpace(HelHandle *handle)
functions.description: Creates a new address space and returns its handle.
requirements: handle must be a non-null pointer to writable memory

functions.name: helCreateVirtualizedSpace
functions.signature: extern inline __attribute__ (( always_inline )) HelError helCreateVirtualizedSpace(HelHandle *handle)
functions.description: Creates a new virtualized address space and returns its handle.
requirements: handle must be a non-null pointer to writable memory

functions.name: helCreateVirtualizedCpu
functions.signature: extern inline __attribute__ (( always_inline )) HelError helCreateVirtualizedCpu(HelHandle handle, HelHandle *out_handle)
functions.description: Creates a virtualized CPU associated with the given handle (likely a virtualized space), returning a CPU handle.
requirements: handle must be a valid handle for virtualized CPU creation
out_handle must be a non-null pointer to writable memory

functions.name: helRunVirtualizedCpu
functions.signature: extern inline __attribute__ (( always_inline )) HelError helRunVirtualizedCpu(HelHandle handle, struct HelVmexitReason *exitInfo)
functions.description: Runs a virtualized CPU until it exits; on exit, information is written to exitInfo.
requirements: handle must be a valid virtualized CPU handle
exitInfo must be a non-null pointer to writable memory to receive exit details

functions.name: helGetRandomBytes
functions.signature: extern inline __attribute__ (( always_inline )) HelError helGetRandomBytes(void *buffer, size_t wantedSize, size_t *actualSize)
functions.description: Fills buffer with up to wantedSize random bytes; returns the actual number written.
requirements: buffer must point to writable memory of at least wantedSize bytes
actualSize must be a non-null pointer to writable memory

functions.name: helMapMemory
functions.signature: extern inline __attribute__ (( always_inline )) HelError helMapMemory(HelHandle handle, HelHandle space, void *pointer, uintptr_t offset, size_t size, uint32_t flags, void **actual_pointer)
functions.description: Maps a range of a memory handle into an address space at a requested address (if provided), returning the actual mapping address.
requirements: handle must be a valid memory handle
space must be a valid address space handle
If pointer is used as a hint/address, it must be an address valid in the target space (exact semantics unknown)
offset and size must specify a valid range in the memory object
flags must be a valid bitmask for mapping (e.g., protections/mapping mode; specifics unknown)
actual_pointer must be a non-null pointer to writable memory to receive the mapped address

functions.name: helSubmitProtectMemory
functions.signature: extern inline __attribute__ (( always_inline )) HelError helSubmitProtectMemory(HelHandle space, void *pointer, size_t size, uint32_t flags, HelHandle queue, uintptr_t context)
functions.description: Submits an asynchronous request to change protection of a memory region in an address space.
requirements: space must be a valid address space handle
pointer must reference the start of the region to protect and be valid in that space
size specifies the length of the region
flags must be a valid protection bitmask (semantics unknown)
queue must be a valid async queue handle

functions.name: helUnmapMemory
functions.signature: extern inline __attribute__ (( always_inline )) HelError helUnmapMemory(HelHandle space, void *pointer, size_t size)
functions.description: Unmaps a region from an address space.
requirements: space must be a valid address space handle
pointer must reference the mapped region
size must match the mapping length (exact constraints unknown)

functions.name: helSubmitSynchronizeSpace
functions.signature: extern inline __attribute__ (( always_inline )) HelError helSubmitSynchronizeSpace(HelHandle space, void *pointer, size_t size, HelHandle queue, uintptr_t context)
functions.description: Submits an asynchronous synchronization operation for a region of an address space.
requirements: space must be valid
pointer and size identify the region; must be valid
queue must be a valid async queue handle

functions.name: helPointerPhysical
functions.signature: extern inline __attribute__ (( always_inline )) HelError helPointerPhysical(const void *pointer, uintptr_t *physical)
functions.description: Translates a virtual pointer to its physical address, returning it in physical.
requirements: pointer must be a valid mapped address
physical must be a non-null pointer to writable memory

functions.name: helSubmitReadMemory
functions.signature: extern inline __attribute__ (( always_inline )) HelError helSubmitReadMemory(HelHandle handle, uintptr_t address, size_t length, void *buffer, HelHandle queue, uintptr_t context)
functions.description: Submits an asynchronous read from a memory object at address/length into buffer.
requirements: handle must be a valid memory-like handle supporting reads
buffer must point to writable memory of at least length bytes
queue must be a valid async queue handle

functions.name: helSubmitWriteMemory
functions.signature: extern inline __attribute__ (( always_inline )) HelError helSubmitWriteMemory(HelHandle handle, uintptr_t address, size_t length, const void *buffer, HelHandle queue, uintptr_t context)
functions.description: Submits an asynchronous write to a memory object from buffer to address/length.
requirements: handle must be a valid memory-like handle supporting writes
buffer must point to at least length bytes of readable memory
queue must be a valid async queue handle

functions.name: helMemoryInfo
functions.signature: extern inline __attribute__ (( always_inline )) HelError helMemoryInfo(HelHandle handle, size_t *size)
functions.description: Returns the size of a memory object in bytes.
requirements: handle must be a valid memory handle
size must be a non-null pointer to writable memory

functions.name: helSubmitManageMemory
functions.signature: extern inline __attribute__ (( always_inline )) HelError helSubmitManageMemory(HelHandle handle, HelHandle queue, uintptr_t context)
functions.description: Submits an asynchronous memory management operation for a memory object.
requirements: handle must be a valid memory handle
queue must be a valid async queue handle

functions.name: helUpdateMemory
functions.signature: extern inline __attribute__ (( always_inline )) HelError helUpdateMemory(HelHandle handle, int type, uintptr_t offset, size_t length)
functions.description: Performs an update operation on a memory object over the given range with a specified type. Exact semantics of type are unknown.
requirements: handle must be a valid memory handle
offset and length must define a valid range within the object
type must be a valid operation type for the OS (exact values unknown)

functions.name: helSubmitLockMemoryView
functions.signature: extern inline __attribute__ (( always_inline )) HelError helSubmitLockMemoryView(HelHandle handle, uintptr_t offset, size_t size, HelHandle queue, uintptr_t context)
functions.description: Submits an asynchronous request to lock a region of a memory view.
requirements: handle must be a valid memory view handle
offset and size must describe a valid range
queue must be a valid async queue handle

functions.name: helLoadahead
functions.signature: extern inline __attribute__ (( always_inline )) HelError helLoadahead(HelHandle handle, uintptr_t offset, size_t length)
functions.description: Hints or requests that a region of a memory object be loaded into cache/backing storage ahead of use.
requirements: handle must be valid
offset and length define the range; must be within the object

functions.name: helCreateThread
functions.signature: extern inline __attribute__ (( always_inline )) HelError helCreateThread(HelHandle universe, HelHandle address_space, HelAbi abi, void *ip, void *sp, uint32_t flags, HelHandle *handle)
functions.description: Creates a new thread in a universe/address space with the specified ABI, instruction pointer, stack pointer, and flags, returning its handle.
requirements: universe must be a valid universe handle
address_space must be a valid address space handle
handle must be a non-null pointer to writable memory
ip and sp must be valid entry and stack addresses for the specified ABI
flags must be a valid bitmask for thread creation (semantics unknown)

functions.name: helQueryThreadStats
functions.signature: extern inline __attribute__ (( always_inline )) HelError helQueryThreadStats(HelHandle handle, struct HelThreadStats *stats)
functions.description: Queries statistics for a thread and writes them into stats.
requirements: handle must be a valid thread handle
stats must be a non-null pointer to writable memory

functions.name: helYield
functions.signature: extern inline __attribute__ (( always_inline )) HelError helYield()
functions.description: Yields the processor to allow other threads to run.

functions.name: helSetPriority
functions.signature: extern inline __attribute__ (( always_inline )) HelError helSetPriority(HelHandle handle, int priority)
functions.description: Sets the scheduling priority of a thread or entity represented by handle.

priority must be within the OS-defined range (exact limits unknown)

functions.name: helSubmitObserve
functions.signature: extern inline __attribute__ (( always_inline )) HelError helSubmitObserve(HelHandle handle, uint64_t in_seq, HelHandle queue, uintptr_t context)

functions.name: helKillThread
functions.signature: extern inline __attribute__ (( always_inline )) HelError helKillThread(HelHandle handle)

functions.name: helInterruptThread
functions.signature: extern inline __attribute__ (( always_inline )) HelError helInterruptThread(HelHandle handle)
functions.description: Interrupts or signals a thread to wake or stop blocking.
requirements: handle must be a valid thread handle

functions.name: helResume

requirements: handle must be a valid thread handle

functions.description: Stores registers for a thread. Name suggests writing thread registers to a buffer, but the parameter type is const; exact directionality is ambiguous. Treat according to OS semantics.

image must point to a buffer appropriate for the register set; size/format depend on set (unknown)

functions.signature: extern inline __attribute__ (( always_inline )) HelError helReadGsBase(void **pointer)
functions.description: Reads the current GS base into pointer.
requirements: pointer must be a non-null pointer to writable memory to receive the GS base value

functions.name: helGetCurrentCpu
functions.signature: extern inline __attribute__ (( always_inline )) HelError helGetCurrentCpu(int *cpu)
functions.description: Returns the current CPU/core ID in cpu.
requirements: cpu must be a non-null pointer to writable memory

functions.name: helGetClock
functions.signature: extern inline __attribute__ (( always_inline )) HelError helGetClock(uint64_t *counter)
functions.description: Reads a system clock counter and writes it to counter.
requirements: counter must be a non-null pointer to writable memory

functions.name: helSubmitAwaitClock
functions.signature: extern inline __attribute__ (( always_inline )) HelError helSubmitAwaitClock(uint64_t counter, HelHandle queue, uintptr_t context, uint64_t *async_id)
functions.description: Submits an async request that completes when the system clock reaches counter; returns an async_id.
requirements: queue must be a valid async queue handle
async_id must be a non-null pointer to writable memory

functions.name: helCreateStream
functions.signature: extern inline __attribute__ (( always_inline )) HelError helCreateStream(HelHandle *lane1, HelHandle *lane2, uint32_t attach_credentials)
functions.description: Creates a bidirectional stream, returning two lane handles. Optionally attaches credentials.
requirements: lane1 and lane2 must be non-null pointers to writable memory
attach_credentials must be a valid flag value (semantics unknown)

functions.name: helSubmitAsync
functions.signature: extern inline __attribute__ (( always_inline )) HelError helSubmitAsync(HelHandle handle, const struct HelAction *actions, size_t count, HelHandle queue, uintptr_t context, uint32_t flags)
functions.description: Submits a batch of actions to a lane/stream or similar handle for asynchronous processing.
requirements: handle must be valid for async submission
actions must point to an array of at least count HelAction entries
count specifies the number of actions
queue must be a valid async queue handle
flags must be a valid bitmask for submission (semantics unknown)

functions.name: helShutdownLane
functions.signature: extern inline __attribute__ (( always_inline )) HelError helShutdownLane(HelHandle handle)
functions.description: Shuts down a communication lane/stream.
requirements: handle must be a valid lane/stream handle

functions.name: helFutexWait
functions.signature: extern inline __attribute__ (( always_inline )) HelError helFutexWait(int *pointer, int expected, int64_t deadline)
functions.description: Waits on a futex located at pointer until its value differs from expected or until deadline.
requirements: pointer must point to a writable int used as a futex word
deadline is a time value; semantics/units unknown

functions.name: helFutexWake
functions.signature: extern inline __attribute__ (( always_inline )) HelError helFutexWake(int *pointer, unsigned int count)
functions.description: Wakes up to count waiters waiting on the futex at pointer.
requirements: pointer must point to a futex int
count specifies the maximum number of waiters to wake

functions.name: helCreateOneshotEvent
functions.signature: extern inline __attribute__ (( always_inline )) HelError helCreateOneshotEvent(HelHandle *handle)
functions.description: Creates a one-shot event object and returns its handle.
requirements: handle must be a non-null pointer to writable memory

functions.name: helCreateBitsetEvent
functions.signature: extern inline __attribute__ (( always_inline )) HelError helCreateBitsetEvent(HelHandle *handle)
functions.description: Creates a bitset event object and returns its handle.
requirements: handle must be a non-null pointer to writable memory

functions.name: helRaiseEvent
functions.signature: extern inline __attribute__ (( always_inline )) HelError helRaiseEvent(HelHandle handle)
functions.description: Raises/signals an event object.
requirements: handle must be a valid event handle

functions.name: helAccessIrq
functions.signature: extern inline __attribute__ (( always_inline )) HelError helAccessIrq(int number, HelHandle *handle)
functions.description: Obtains a handle for accessing a hardware interrupt (IRQ) by number.
requirements: handle must be a non-null pointer to writable memory
number must be a valid IRQ number for the system

functions.name: helAcknowledgeIrq
functions.signature: extern inline __attribute__ (( always_inline )) HelError helAcknowledgeIrq(HelHandle handle, uint32_t flags, uint64_t sequence)
functions.description: Acknowledges an interrupt on the given IRQ handle, with flags and sequence to control behavior.
requirements: handle must be a valid IRQ handle
flags must be a valid bitmask (semantics unknown)
sequence must match the expected event sequence

functions.name: helSubmitAwaitEvent
functions.signature: extern inline __attribute__ (( always_inline )) HelError helSubmitAwaitEvent(HelHandle handle, uint64_t sequence, HelHandle queue, uintptr_t context, uint64_t *async_id)
functions.description: Submits an async request to await an event reaching a specified sequence number; returns an async_id.
requirements: handle must be a valid event/IRQ-like handle
queue must be a valid async queue handle
async_id must be a non-null pointer to writable memory

functions.name: helAutomateIrq
functions.signature: extern inline __attribute__ (( always_inline )) HelError helAutomateIrq(HelHandle handle, uint32_t flags, HelHandle kernlet)
functions.description: Attaches automation to an IRQ using a kernlet with specified flags.
requirements: handle must be a valid IRQ handle
kernlet must be a valid kernlet handle
flags must be a valid bitmask (semantics unknown)

functions.name: helAccessIo
functions.signature: extern inline __attribute__ (( always_inline )) HelError helAccessIo(uintptr_t *port_array, size_t num_ports, HelHandle *handle)
functions.description: Grants access to a set of I/O ports specified in port_array, returning an I/O handle.
requirements: port_array must point to an array of at least num_ports entries
num_ports specifies the number of ports
handle must be a non-null pointer to writable memory

functions.name: helEnableIo
functions.signature: extern inline __attribute__ (( always_inline )) HelError helEnableIo(HelHandle handle)
functions.description: Enables I/O access on a previously obtained I/O handle.
requirements: handle must be a valid I/O handle

functions.name: helEnableFullIo
functions.signature: extern inline __attribute__ (( always_inline )) HelError helEnableFullIo()
functions.description: Enables full I/O privileges for the calling context.

functions.name: helBindKernlet
functions.signature: extern inline __attribute__ (( always_inline )) HelError helBindKernlet(HelHandle handle, const union HelKernletData *data, size_t num_data, HelHandle *bound_handle)
functions.description: Binds a kernlet with the provided data array and returns a bound kernlet handle.
requirements: handle must be a valid kernlet handle
data must point to an array of at least num_data HelKernletData entries (or be null if allowed; unknown)
bound_handle must be a non-null pointer to writable memory

functions.name: helGetAffinity
functions.signature: extern inline __attribute__ (( always_inline )) HelError helGetAffinity(HelHandle handle, uint8_t *mask, size_t size, size_t *actualSize)
functions.description: Retrieves the CPU affinity mask for a handle into mask, writing the number of bytes written or required to actualSize.
requirements: handle must be valid
mask must point to writable memory of at least size bytes
actualSize must be a non-null pointer to writable memory

functions.name: helSetAffinity
functions.signature: extern inline __attribute__ (( always_inline )) HelError helSetAffinity(HelHandle handle, uint8_t *mask, size_t size)
functions.description: Sets the CPU affinity for a handle using the provided mask buffer of size bytes.
requirements: handle must be valid
mask must point to readable memory of at least size bytes
size must match the expected mask length for the system (exact size unknown)

functions.name: helQueryRegisterInfo
functions.signature: extern inline __attribute__ (( always_inline )) HelError helQueryRegisterInfo(int set, struct HelRegisterInfo *info)
functions.description: Queries information about a register set and writes it into info.
requirements: info must be a non-null pointer to writable memory
set must be a valid register set identifier

functions.name: helCreateToken
functions.signature: extern inline __attribute__ (( always_inline )) HelError helCreateToken(HelHandle *handle)
functions.description: Creates a token object and returns its handle.
requirements: handle must be a non-null pointer to writable memory

functions.name: helLog
functions.signature: HelError helLog(enum HelLogSeverity severity, const char *string, size_t length);
functions.description: Writes a text message to the kernel’s log with the given RFC 5424 severity. Use to emit diagnostic or status output from userspace.
requirements: string may be NULL only if length is 0; otherwise must point to at least length bytes
length is the number of bytes to log (not necessarily NUL-terminated)
Returns HelError to indicate success or failure

functions.name: helPanic
functions.signature: void helPanic(const char *string, size_t length);
functions.description: Terminates the current thread and writes an error message to the kernel’s log. Intended for unrecoverable failures; it does not return.
requirements: This function never returns (noreturn)
string may be NULL when length is 0; otherwise must reference at least length bytes that can be logged

functions.name: helNop
functions.signature: HelError helNop(void);
functions.description: No-op syscall useful for profiling or connectivity checks.

functions.name: helSubmitAsyncNop
functions.signature: HelError helSubmitAsyncNop(HelHandle queueHandle, uintptr_t context);
functions.description: Submits an asynchronous no-op to a queue, useful for measuring async overhead or testing queue flow.
requirements: queueHandle must reference a valid queue created by helCreateQueue
context is an opaque user value echoed in completion

functions.name: helCreateUniverse
functions.signature: HelError helCreateUniverse(HelHandle *handle);
functions.description: Creates a new universe descriptor and returns its handle.
requirements: handle must be a non-NULL pointer to receive the new handle

functions.name: helTransferDescriptor
functions.signature: HelError helTransferDescriptor(HelHandle handle, HelHandle universeHandle, enum HelTransferDescriptorFlags direction, HelHandle *outHandle);
functions.description: Copies a descriptor between universes. Produces a handle valid in the target universe.
requirements: handle must be a valid descriptor in the calling universe
universeHandle must reference the destination universe
outHandle must be non-NULL to receive the copied handle
direction selects transfer direction (in/out) per enum HelTransferDescriptorFlags

functions.name: helDescriptorInfo
functions.signature: HelError helDescriptorInfo(HelHandle handle, struct HelDescriptorInfo *info);
functions.description: Returns type information about a descriptor.
requirements: handle must be a valid descriptor
info must be a non-NULL pointer to receive information

functions.name: helGetCredentials
functions.signature: HelError helGetCredentials(HelHandle handle, uint32_t flags, char *credentials);
functions.description: Returns the 16-byte credentials associated with a descriptor.
requirements: handle must be a valid descriptor
credentials must point to a writable buffer of at least 16 bytes
flags usage is unspecified; pass 0 unless otherwise documented

functions.name: helCloseDescriptor
functions.signature: HelError helCloseDescriptor(HelHandle universeHandle, HelHandle handle);
functions.description: Closes a descriptor within a given universe.
requirements: universeHandle must reference the universe containing handle
handle must be a valid open handle within universeHandle

functions.name: helCreateQueue
functions.signature: HelError helCreateQueue(const struct HelQueueParameters *params, HelHandle *handle);
functions.description: Creates an in-memory kernel/userspace IPC queue and returns its handle.
requirements: params must be non-NULL and initialized (flags, numChunks, chunkSize)
handle must be non-NULL to receive the queue handle

functions.name: helCancelAsync
functions.signature: HelError helCancelAsync(HelHandle queueHandle, uint64_t asyncId);
functions.description: Attempts to cancel an ongoing asynchronous operation previously submitted to a queue.
requirements: queueHandle must be a valid queue
asyncId must be an identifier returned by a prior async submission on that queue

functions.name: helDriveQueue
functions.signature: HelError helDriveQueue(HelHandle queueHandle, uint32_t flags);
functions.description: Signals the kernel that userspace supplied new chunks; optionally waits for CQ progress when kHelDriveWaitCqProgress is set.
requirements: queueHandle must be a valid queue handle
flags is a bitmask; may include kHelDriveWaitCqProgress

functions.name: helAllocateMemory
functions.signature: HelError helAllocateMemory(size_t size, uint32_t flags, const struct HelAllocRestrictions *restrictions, HelHandle *handle);
functions.description: Creates a memory object backed by unmanaged RAM.
requirements: size must be page-size aligned
handle must be non-NULL to receive the memory object handle
restrictions may be NULL or must point to a valid HelAllocRestrictions
flags may include HelAllocFlags values (e.g., kHelAllocContinuous, kHelAllocOnDemand)

functions.name: helResizeMemory
functions.signature: HelError helResizeMemory(HelHandle handle, size_t newSize);
functions.description: Resizes an existing memory object to a new size.
requirements: handle must be a valid memory object
newSize must be page-size aligned

functions.name: helCreateManagedMemory
functions.signature: HelError helCreateManagedMemory(size_t size, uint32_t flags, HelHandle *backingHandle, HelHandle *frontalHandle);
functions.description: Creates a userspace-managed memory object, returning a backing handle for management and a frontal handle for consumers.
requirements: size must be page-size aligned
backingHandle and frontalHandle must be non-NULL
flags may include HelManagedFlags (semantics per system)

functions.name: helCopyOnWrite
functions.signature: HelError helCopyOnWrite(HelHandle memory, uintptr_t offset, size_t size, HelHandle *handle);
functions.description: Creates a memory object that obtains its pages via copy-on-write from another memory object.
requirements: memory must be a valid memory object
offset must be page-size aligned
size must be page-size aligned
handle must be non-NULL to receive the new memory object

functions.name: helAccessPhysical
functions.signature: HelError helAccessPhysical(uintptr_t physical, size_t size, HelHandle *handle);
functions.description: Creates a memory object that maps access to a physical address range.
requirements: physical must be a valid physical address aligned as required by the system (at least page-size alignment implied)
size should be page-size aligned
handle must be non-NULL

functions.name: helCreateIndirectMemory
functions.signature: HelError helCreateIndirectMemory(size_t numSlots, HelHandle *handle);
functions.description: Creates an indirect memory object that delegates to other memory objects via slots.
requirements: numSlots specifies the number of slots; must be >= 1 (by implication)
handle must be non-NULL

functions.signature: HelError helAlterMemoryIndirection(HelHandle indirectHandle, size_t slotIndex, HelHandle memoryHandle, uintptr_t offset, size_t size);
functions.description: Modifies one slot of an indirect memory object to delegate to a given memory range of another memory object.
requirements: indirectHandle must be created by helCreateIndirectMemory
slotIndex must be in [0, numSlots) of the indirect object
memoryHandle must be a valid memory object
offset must be page-size aligned
size must be page-size aligned

functions.name: helCreateSliceView
functions.signature: HelError helCreateSliceView(HelHandle bundle, uintptr_t offset, size_t size, uint32_t flags, HelHandle *handle);
functions.description: Creates a slice view into a memory bundle/object at the given offset and size, possibly with slice-specific flags.
requirements: bundle must be a valid handle to a compatible memory bundle/object
offset and size should be page-size aligned if mapping semantics require it
handle must be non-NULL
flags may include HelSliceFlags (e.g., kHelSliceCacheWriteCombine)

functions.name: helForkMemory
functions.signature: HelError helForkMemory(HelHandle handle, HelHandle *forkedHandle);
functions.description: Forks a copy-on-write memory object, producing a new COW object that initially shares pages.
requirements: handle must refer to a memory object created by helCopyOnWrite
forkedHandle must be non-NULL

functions.name: helCreateSpace
functions.signature: HelError helCreateSpace(HelHandle *handle);
functions.description: Creates a new virtual address space for threads.
requirements: handle must be non-NULL to receive the new space handle

functions.name: helMapMemory
functions.signature: HelError helMapMemory(HelHandle memoryHandle, HelHandle spaceHandle, void *pointer, uintptr_t offset, size_t size, uint32_t flags, void **actualPointer);
functions.description: Maps a region of a memory object into an address space. If pointer is NULL, the kernel chooses the address and returns it via actualPointer.
requirements: memoryHandle must be a valid memory object
spaceHandle must be a valid address space handle
pointer may be NULL to request arbitrary placement; otherwise should be appropriately aligned and available
offset must be page-size aligned
size must be page-size aligned
actualPointer must be non-NULL to receive the mapped address
flags may include HelMapFlags (e.g., kHelMapProtRead/Write/Execute, kHelMapFixed, kHelMapFixedNoReplace, kHelMapDontRequireBacking)

functions.name: helSubmitProtectMemory
functions.signature: HelError helSubmitProtectMemory(HelHandle spaceHandle, void *pointer, size_t size, uint32_t flags, HelHandle queueHandle, uintptr_t context);
functions.description: Asynchronously changes protection attributes of a mapped memory range within an address space.
requirements: spaceHandle must be a valid address space containing the mapping
pointer must be page-size aligned and refer to a mapped region
size must be page-size aligned
flags encodes protection settings (HelMapProt*); semantics per system
queueHandle must be a valid queue; context is user-defined

functions.name: helSubmitSynchronizeSpace
functions.signature: HelError helSubmitSynchronizeSpace(HelHandle spaceHandle, void *pointer, size_t size, HelHandle queueHandle, uintptr_t context);
functions.description: Asynchronously notifies the kernel of dirty pages in a mapping and returns after the scan completes (does not wait for writeback).
requirements: spaceHandle must be a valid address space
pointer must be page-size aligned
size must be page-size aligned
queueHandle must be a valid queue; context is user-defined

functions.name: helUnmapMemory
functions.signature: HelError helUnmapMemory(HelHandle spaceHandle, void *pointer, size_t size);
functions.description: Unmaps a previously mapped region from an address space.
requirements: spaceHandle must be a valid address space
pointer must be page-size aligned and refer to a mapping
size must be page-size aligned

functions.name: helPointerPhysical
functions.signature: HelError helPointerPhysical(const void *pointer, uintptr_t *physical);
functions.description: Translates a virtual pointer to its corresponding physical address.
requirements: pointer must be a valid mapped address
physical must be non-NULL to receive the physical address

functions.name: helSubmitReadMemory
functions.signature: HelError helSubmitReadMemory(HelHandle handle, uintptr_t address, size_t length, void *buffer, HelHandle queue, uintptr_t context);
functions.description: Asynchronously reads bytes from a descriptor’s address space into a userspace buffer.
requirements: handle must be an addressable descriptor (address space or virtualized space)
address is the source address relative to handle
length is the number of bytes to read
buffer must point to writable memory of at least length bytes
queue must be a valid queue; context is user-defined

functions.name: helSubmitWriteMemory
functions.signature: HelError helSubmitWriteMemory(HelHandle handle, uintptr_t address, size_t length, const void *buffer, HelHandle queue, uintptr_t context);
functions.description: Asynchronously writes bytes from userspace buffer into a descriptor’s address space.
requirements: handle must be an addressable descriptor (address space or virtualized space)
address is the destination address relative to handle
length is the number of bytes to write
buffer must point to readable memory of at least length bytes
queue must be a valid queue; context is user-defined

functions.name: helMemoryInfo
functions.signature: HelError helMemoryInfo(HelHandle handle, size_t *size);
functions.description: Returns information about a memory object; currently its total size in bytes.
requirements: handle must be a valid memory object
size must be non-NULL to receive the size

functions.name: helSubmitManageMemory
functions.signature: HelError helSubmitManageMemory(HelHandle handle, HelHandle queue, uintptr_t context);
functions.description: Asynchronously initiates a memory-management operation (e.g., initialize or writeback) on a managed memory object.

queue must be a valid queue; context is user-defined

functions.name: helUpdateMemory
functions.signature: HelError helUpdateMemory(HelHandle handle, int type, uintptr_t offset, size_t length);
functions.description: Updates a range of a managed memory object (e.g., to notify kernel about state changes).

type must be a valid update code for the system (e.g., HelManageRequests)
offset and length specify the affected range; alignment may be required by the system

functions.signature: HelError helSubmitLockMemoryView(HelHandle handle, uintptr_t offset, size_t size, HelHandle queue, uintptr_t context);
functions.description: Asynchronously locks a view of a memory object to prevent paging or to pin it for I/O.
requirements: handle must be a valid memory object/view
offset and size define the region; page-size alignment may be required
queue must be a valid queue; context is user-defined

functions.name: helLoadahead
functions.signature: HelError helLoadahead(HelHandle handle, uintptr_t offset, size_t length);
functions.description: Hints to the kernel to preload the specified memory range to improve performance. The kernel may ignore the hint.
requirements: handle must be a valid memory object
offset and length specify the range; page-size alignment is recommended

functions.name: helCreateVirtualizedSpace
functions.signature: HelError helCreateVirtualizedSpace(HelHandle *handle);
functions.description: Creates a virtualized address space used with virtualized CPUs.
requirements: handle must be non-NULL to receive the new virtualized space handle

functions.name: helCreateThread
functions.signature: HelError helCreateThread(HelHandle universe, HelHandle spaceHandle, HelAbi abi, void *ip, void *sp, uint32_t flags, HelHandle *handle);
functions.description: Creates a new thread in the given universe and address space with the specified ABI, instruction pointer, and stack pointer.

stats must be non-NULL

functions.description: Sets the scheduling priority of a thread; higher values run before lower ones. Default is 0.
requirements: handle must be a valid thread handle

functions.name: helYield
functions.signature: HelError helYield(void);
functions.description: Yields the processor from the current thread, allowing others to run.

functions.name: helSubmitObserve
functions.signature: HelError helSubmitObserve(HelHandle handle, uint64_t sequence, HelHandle queue, uintptr_t context);
functions.description: Asynchronously observes state changes of a thread, given the last seen sequence number.

queue must be a valid queue; context is user-defined

functions.name: helKillThread

functions.description: Terminates the specified thread.

functions.name: helInterruptThread

functions.description: Temporarily suspends a thread; it can later be resumed with helResume.
requirements: handle must be a valid thread handle

functions.name: helResume

functions.description: Resumes a suspended or fault-stopped thread.
requirements: handle must be a valid thread handle

functions.description: Loads a copy of a thread’s register image for the specified register set into the provided buffer.

set must be a valid HelRegisterSets value
image must point to a buffer large enough for the selected set (see helQueryRegisterInfo)

functions.name: helStoreRegisters
functions.signature: HelError helStoreRegisters(HelHandle handle, int set, const void *image);
functions.description: Stores the provided register image into a thread for the specified register set.
requirements: handle must be a valid thread handle
set must be a valid HelRegisterSets value
image must point to a buffer containing a full register image for the set (size from helQueryRegisterInfo)

functions.name: helQueryRegisterInfo
functions.signature: HelError helQueryRegisterInfo(int set, struct HelRegisterInfo *info);
functions.description: Returns information (e.g., image size) about a register set.
requirements: set must be a valid HelRegisterSets value
info must be non-NULL

functions.name: helWriteFsBase

functions.name: helReadFsBase

functions.name: helWriteGsBase

functions.description: Sets the GS base register for the current thread.
requirements: pointer must be a valid address for use as GS base per platform constraints

functions.name: helReadGsBase
functions.signature: HelError helReadGsBase(void **pointer);
functions.description: Reads the GS base register of the current thread.
requirements: pointer must be non-NULL to receive the GS base

functions.name: helGetCurrentCpu
functions.signature: HelError helGetCurrentCpu(int *cpu);
functions.description: Returns the index of the CPU that the calling thread is currently running on.

functions.name: helGetClock

functions.description: Reads the system-wide monotonic clock value in nanoseconds since boot.

reason must be non-NULL to receive exit information

functions.name: helGetRandomBytes

actualSize may be non-NULL to receive the number of bytes written

functions.name: helGetAffinity
functions.signature: HelError helGetAffinity(HelHandle handle, uint8_t *mask, size_t size, size_t *actualSize);
functions.description: Retrieves a thread’s CPU affinity bitmask.
requirements: handle must be a valid thread handle
mask must point to a buffer of size bytes
actualSize must be non-NULL to receive bytes written

functions.name: helSetAffinity
functions.signature: HelError helSetAffinity(HelHandle handle, uint8_t *mask, size_t size);
functions.description: Sets a thread’s CPU affinity bitmask.
requirements: handle must be a valid thread handle
mask must point to a readable buffer of size bytes representing the CPU bitmask

functions.signature: HelError helCreateStream(HelHandle *lane1, HelHandle *lane2, uint32_t attach_credentials);

functions.name: helShutdownLane

functions.name: helCreateToken

functions.description: Creates a token object encapsulating credentials that can be shared and used for ImbueCredentials.
requirements: handle must be non-NULL

import random
import struct
import string

# Data type: NUL-terminated string or NULL
# Target stub: _helCheckFailed(err_code:int, const char *string_or_null, fatal=0)
# FUZZ_PARAM_STR consumes a buffer as an std::string. We should provide
# bytes that often represent valid, printable, NUL-terminated C strings,
# sometimes empty, sometimes with embedded NULs, and occasionally non-UTF8.
# The stub may also pass NULL if the msg is empty and a separate random bit is set.
# Hence, generating an empty buffer is useful to exercise the NULL path.
# We seed randomness for reproducibility.

PRINTABLE = string.printable.encode('utf-8')

def _rand_printable(rng: random.Random, n: int) -> bytes:
    return bytes(rng.choice(PRINTABLE) for _ in range(n))

def _rand_bytes(rng: random.Random, n: int) -> bytes:
    return rng.randbytes(n) if hasattr(rng, 'randbytes') else bytes(rng.getrandbits(8) for _ in range(n))

def _make_cstring(rng: random.Random) -> bytes:
    # Choose a strategy to cover different cases
    strat = rng.choices(
        population=[
            'empty',            # empty -> enables NULL path in stub sometimes
            'short_printable',  # short human-readable
            'long_printable',   # longer readable
            'with_nul_inside',  # embedded NUL before final terminator
            'binary',           # arbitrary bytes
            'utf8',             # valid UTF-8 with multibyte
            'error_like',       # looks like an error message
        ],
        weights=[10, 25, 15, 10, 15, 10, 15],
        k=1
    )[0]

    if strat == 'empty':
        s = b''
    elif strat == 'short_printable':
        n = rng.randrange(1, 32)
        s = _rand_printable(rng, n)
    elif strat == 'long_printable':
        n = rng.randrange(64, 512)
        s = _rand_printable(rng, n)
    elif strat == 'with_nul_inside':
        # create segments separated by NUL to test early-termination behavior in C
        parts = []
        k = rng.randrange(2, 6)
        for _ in range(k):
            parts.append(_rand_printable(rng, rng.randrange(0, 16)))
        s = b"\x00".join(parts)
    elif strat == 'binary':
        n = rng.randrange(1, 256)
        s = _rand_bytes(rng, n)
    elif strat == 'utf8':
        # Construct some multibyte UTF-8 sequences
        chunks = []
        n = rng.randrange(8, 256)
        while len(b"".join(chunks)) < n:
            choice = rng.randrange(4)
            if choice == 0:
                # ASCII
                chunks.append(bytes([rng.randrange(0x20, 0x7F)]))
            elif choice == 1:
                # 2-byte
                cp = rng.randrange(0x80, 0x7FF)
                chunks.append(chr(cp).encode('utf-8'))
            elif choice == 2:
                # 3-byte
                cp = rng.randrange(0x800, 0xFFFF)
                # avoid surrogates
                if 0xD800 <= cp <= 0xDFFF:
                    cp = 0xE000 + (cp - 0xD800)
                chunks.append(chr(cp).encode('utf-8'))
            else:
                # 4-byte
                cp = rng.randrange(0x10000, 0x10FFFF)
                chunks.append(chr(cp).encode('utf-8'))
        s = b"".join(chunks)[:n]
    else:  # 'error_like'
        # Include typical error keywords, numbers, and hex codes
        templates = [
            b"HEL_CHECK failed: err=%d (%s)",
            b"error %d: %s",
            b"fatal: code=%d msg=%s",
            b"_helCheckFailed(%d): %s",
            b"errno=%d [%s]",
        ]
        err = rng.randrange(-4096, 4096)
        words = [
            b"invalid", b"permission", b"timeout", b"not found", b"busy",
            b"range", b"overflow", b"underflow", b"io", b"bug",
        ]
        msg = rng.choice(words)
        # Occasionally append hex code
        if rng.random() < 0.5:
            msg += b" 0x" + format(rng.getrandbits(32), '08x').encode()
        s = rng.choice(templates) % (err, msg)

    # Ensure there is a terminal NUL often (C-style). The stub passes std::string.c_str(),
    # which is NUL-terminated, but embedding an explicit NUL is still useful. We'll append
    # a NUL with high probability unless the string is empty to preserve the NULL path option.
    if s and rng.random() < 0.8:
        if not s.endswith(b"\x00"):
            s = s + b"\x00"
    # Cap size to 4096 bytes
    return s[:4096]


def generate(seed: int) -> bytes:
    rng = random.Random(seed)

    # Occasionally generate an empty buffer to drive the NULL-pointer branch in the stub
    if rng.random() < 0.15:
        return b""  # FUZZ_PARAM_STR will be empty; stub may turn it into NULL

    s = _make_cstring(rng)

    # Prepend a small header occasionally to simulate prefixes that callers might log
    # without breaking validity (still just bytes for std::string)
    if rng.random() < 0.3:
        prefixes = [b"INFO: ", b"WARN: ", b"ERROR: ", b"DEBUG: ", b"ASSERT: "]
        s = rng.choice(prefixes) + s

    return s[:4096]
